findings.evidence: mathlib Analysis/Convex/Contractible.lean:39 `instance RealTopologicalVectorSpace.contractibleSpace : ContractibleSpace E` under exactly those TVS hypotheses; the PR proof body is just `isEmpty_homeomorph_of_simplyConnectedSpace p hp E`.
findings.fix: State the intermediate lemma for a real TVS: `(E : Type*) [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [TopologicalSpace E] [ContinuousAdd E] [ContinuousSMul ℝ E]`, and derive the normed-space and ℝ versions as specializations.
findings.issue: isEmpty_homeomorph_normedSpace requires [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E], but the proof only needs SimplyConnectedSpace E, which holds for any real topological vector space via RealTopologicalVectorSpace.contractibleSpace (mathlib Analysis/Convex/Contractible.lean:39). The norm is entirely unused and is stronger than the natural Mathlib level the PR itself cites.

findings.evidence: Lines 60-69: `e` is consumed only to build `fundamentalGroupMulEquiv p hp e`; the group in the conclusion never mentions `e`. AddCircle's coe is surjective, so `(↑) ⁻¹' {x}` is always nonempty.
findings.fix: Drop `e`: state `(hp : p ≠ 0) (x : AddCircle p) : Nontrivial/Infinite (FundamentalGroup (AddCircle p) x)` and obtain a lift internally via surjectivity of the covering projection.
findings.issue: nontrivial_fundamentalGroup and infinite_fundamentalGroup take an explicit lift `e : (↑) ⁻¹' {x}` that does not appear in the conclusion (a Prop about FundamentalGroup (AddCircle p) x). A lift always exists (the quotient coe is surjective), so the hypothesis needlessly forces callers to supply data for a purely existence-independent statement.

summary: Two under-generalizations: the normed-space homeomorphism lemma imposes an unused norm where a real topological vector space suffices (matching the cited RealTopologicalVectorSpace.contractibleSpace), and the nontrivial/infinite fundamental-group lemmas carry an unnecessary explicit-lift hypothesis that never appears in the conclusion.
